summary: Western Midstream Operating, LP files a preliminary prospectus supplement to offer % Senior Notes due 2036. The terms are incomplete: aggregate principal amount, interest rate, and maturity date are left blank. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing and future senior indebtedness. Proceeds before expenses are to be determined. No tender offer, acquisition, or other special situation is involved; this is a routine debt offering under an existing shelf registration. The filing does not trigger any special-situations event; it is an ordinary capital markets transaction.
